text:
maya: Quick sync — we're scheduling the infra migration + feature rollout next Wed. Main open items: feature-flag dependency graph, per-tenant kill-switches, canary buckets, and objective launch gates. Who wants to own the dependency mapping?

sam: I can own the dependency mapping. proposal: treat the migration as a hard dependency in the flag graph (shipping_v2 only enabled if db_migration=true), but allow a force-override flag for experiments. small cohorts first.

priya: +1. Customers asked for an explicit per-tenant override and a documented rollback contact. For the top 5 enterprise tenants we should pre-enable the fallback route and test it manually.

gabe: Telemetry gates we should enforce automatically: if aggregated error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 30% vs baseline for 5m then auto-roll back that cohort. Also require successful end-to-end smoke for at least 3 sample tenants before 10% traffic.

sam: Draft of flag graph snippet (for reference):
```yaml
flags:
  - name: db_migration_done
    type: boolean
  - name: shipping_v2
    depends_on: [db_migration_done]
    rollout: [0.5, 2, 10, 50, 100] # percents
  - name: shipping_v2_force
    description: override for experiments / QA
```

maya: Launch criteria checklist (proposed):
- Canary 0.5% for 30m with no increased errors
- Canary 2% for 1h with metrics stable
- P95 < 250ms for read path, < 400ms for write path
- Error rate < 0.5%
- Fallback route exercised and validated on 3 tenants
- Runbook + oncall paging tested
- Legal/data team sign-off for the migration (if any schema changes)

priya: For enterprise customers we need a holiday-safe window and a tenant-level kill-switch API. Customers also want SLA exceptions documented. I'll compile the contact list and preferred outage windows.

gabe: Ops notes: implement an ephemeral routing fallback in the proxy that can flip per-tenant. Pseudocode:
```js
if (telemetry[tenant].errors_5m > threshold) {
  setFlag(tenant, 'route_to_v1', true);
  alert('#oncall', `auto-fallback: ${tenant}`);
}
```
We should keep fallback logs for 7d and attach to the incident.

sam: Rollout cadence I propose: 0.5% (30m) -> 2% (1h) -> 10% (2h) -> 50% (4h) -> 100% (monitor 24h). We can abort and rollback any step. Will add gating in the CI job that updates flags.

maya: Agree. Also add a step to run regression evals for quality before >=10% (QA embeddings/baseline tests). If quality regression > configured threshold, hold and notify product.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z -> window reserved, playbook created.

priya: One more ask from a customer: ability to opt their traffic into the new variant but keep billing on old pipeline for 48h. Can we support dual-write + billing toggle?

sam: Dual-write is possible but adds complexity. Suggest we limit that to top 2 customers after manual sign-off. Will document the risks.

maya: Action items: sam -> create flag graph PR + rollout script; gabe -> implement auto-fallback and alerting; priya -> customer contact list + opt-in contract templates; me -> finalize launch criteria and runbook, schedule shiproom. Meeting in 24h to confirm. :thumbsup:
